name: Kyodai
description: Kyodai is the guardian kami of Kamigawa, whose soul is bound to the emperor and who speaks through her.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Kyodai is distracted and oni begin escaping into the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: oni began escaping into the mortal realm

citation.text: "Demon", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband but is confronted by the brother.
timeline.quote: He successfully assassinated the late emperor's husband

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai strips the Konda family of their hereditary rule; future rulers will be elected by the kami.
timeline.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeshi Konda steals the essence of a kami from the Kakuriyo on the night of Michiko's birth, imprisoning it and awakening O-Kagachi, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: this act awoke the prisoner's parent, beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa steals The Taken One from Eiganjo and performs a ritual to free the spirit, who takes the name Kyodai.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai, meaning "sibling."

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai brings Michiko into the Kakuriyo and gives her the power to fight alongside her.
timeline.quote: After that, she gave Michiko the power to fight alongside her.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeat Konda and O-Kagachi and become guardians of the barrier between realms.
timeline.quote: defeated Konda and O-Kagachi and claimed themselves the guardians of the barrier between the Utsushiyo and the Kakuriyo.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko shatters the disk, freeing the Taken One, who becomes Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters and destroy O-Kagachi.
timeline.quote: together they destroyed O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai punishes Konda; the sisters become the new guardians of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Kyodai later punished Konda for his crime as well.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, casting it as a stone disk.
timeline.quote: he tore out O-Kagachi's "heart," its divinity

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko touches the disk, releasing Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
timeline.quote: Together, they destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai turns Konda to stone and shatters him; Hidetsugu emerges merged with the oni and Mochi is eaten.
timeline.quote: Mochi was torn apart and eaten by the oni's jaws.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One during the chaos.
timeline.quote: He stole the Taken One from the pedestal

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi senses the Taken One's absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.
timeline.quote: leaving in its wake the ruins of Konda's kingdom

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi is briefly captured by orochi led by Sosuke, and then tormented by dreams from Uyo and Chiyo confronting him with his misdeeds.
timeline.quote: calling him an oath-breaker

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda arrives at Jukai and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi; Toshi teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm against her command.
timeline.quote: he teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai; O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads.
timeline.quote: Toshi suggests " Kyodai ", meaning "sibling"

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads; Konda is turned to stone and shattered.
timeline.quote: Konda then shows up but is quickly turned to stone and shattered

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sisters take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology and plan a blending of the two worlds.
timeline.quote: The sisters then take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai summons Hidetsugu, now the new chaos oni, who eats Mochi.
timeline.quote: then Hidetsugu eats Mochi

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu devours the failed oni, becomes the most formidable demonic entity, and is imprisoned in the spirit realm by Kyodai.
timeline.quote: His cruelties and the destruction he wreaked throughout the land caused Kyodai to personally intervene and imprison him in the spirit realm

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko uncovers the real cause of the Kami War with Kyodai's support, facing opposition.
timeline.quote: she made the bold choice to uncover the real cause behind the Kami War for all to see

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Reign of Truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One in Jukai Forest; she takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai and bound her power with Princess Michiko Konda

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai and Michiko immobilize and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off its remaining heads.
timeline.quote: bit off O-Kagachi's remaining heads, then cast the limp body aside

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil; the war ends.
timeline.quote: The war ended soon after the Serpent's defeat

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Centuries later the Sisters order Leshrac to leave their plane.
timeline.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Future Sight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around age fourteen, the Wanderer's spark is ignited when Tezzeret tries to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip, leaving her spark unstable.
timeline.quote: The Chip left her spark unstable, causing the irregularities with her planeswalking ability.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito reflects that it has been a year since the emperor went missing, the night he chased a stranger out of Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: It had only been a year since the emperor went missing.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito hears Kyodai's voice and runs after it hoping the emperor has returned, but finds only the tanuki-shaped kami.
timeline.quote: Instead, he saw the tanuki-shaped kami, with glowing white eyes and translucent fur.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Kyodai writhing in distress and the emperor missing.
timeline.quote: But now Kyodai writhed in the water, lashing at the fog like she was hurting and confused.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito sees the man with the metal arm rise from the fog beside Kyodai.
timeline.quote: and a metal arm that pulsed with purple energy, the ends forming a monstrous claw.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
timeline.quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Using her bond with Kyodai to stabilize her spark, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer planeswalked out of Eiganjo and into Tameshi's compound with a flash of light.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
timeline.quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Risona has brought an army.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and offers her surrender.
timeline.quote: "Drop your blade. There is no need for you to die this way."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
timeline.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Imperials invoke Kyodai's name to banish a foe.
timeline.quote: In the name of Kyodai, begone!

citation.text: Banishing Slash (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aoha declares peace under Kyodai's guidance.
timeline.quote: Now, united at last under Kyodai's guidance, we lay down our weapons and open our minds.

citation.text: Hand of Enlightenment (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko Konda bonds with Kyodai, ending the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

citation.text: Portrait of Michiko (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband during a succession civil war, and Kyodai strips the Konda family of its right to rule.
timeline.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tries to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip, destabilizing the emperor's spark and leaving Kyodai dazed.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Tezzeret attempted to control Kyodai using a prototype Reality Chip .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor returns and appoints Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: the two agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer briefly returns to Kamigawa, meets Kaito, and reconnects with Kyodai thanks to the Reality Chip; she and Kyodai appoint Light-Paws acting Regent.
timeline.quote: she and the spirit agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: it's the emperor.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Kyodai, the Wanderer cuts Tamiyo down.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo falls.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: With Kyodai distracted, oni begin escaping into the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: oni began escaping into the mortal realm.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai's power flows through the emperor to rescue Kaito and kill compleated Tamiyo; oni escape into the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: Kyodai's power flowed through the emperor, helping her rescue Kaito and kill the compleated Tamiyo .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
timeline.quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter guides Niko and the Wanderer, who follow Kyodai's glimmer through the House.
timeline.quote: Winter warned Niko and the Wanderer not to step on the moths

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai strips the Konda family of rulership; emperors will be chosen by kami.
timeline.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

citation.text: "Imperials", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Kyodai's guidance, the Imperials usher in an age of peace and prosperity.
timeline.quote: the Imperials ushered in an age of collective peace and prosperity

citation.text: "Imperials", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda performs an arcane ritual with moonfolk and wizard allies and kidnaps O-Kagachi's child, imprisoning it in a stone disk.
timeline.quote: Konda tore the god-child out of the spirit realm and brought it into the physical world

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year Michiko Konda, aided by Toshiro Umezawa, frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Lord Konda, ending the war.
timeline.quote: managed to free the kidnapped scion

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear witnesses O-Kagachi's appearance, the climactic battle and the Daimyo's fate.
timeline.quote: She witnessed the climactic battle above the boughs, as well as the Daimyo's ultimate fate.

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret and the Saiba Futurists develop the Reality Chip; a prototype fails to control Kyodai but ignites the Emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: The Chip ignited the Emperor 's planeswalker's spark but left it unstable

citation.text: "Reality Chip", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda performed a sacrilegious ritual breaking the barrier between mortal and spirit worlds and imprisoned a major spirit, gaining immortality.
timeline.quote: he broke the barrier between the mortal and spirit worlds

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "Konda's Crime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the climax of the war Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters Michiko and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, petrified him and crushed him into a million pieces.
timeline.quote: the Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, then petrified his immortal body and crushed him into a million pieces

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Michiko was the first mortal to bond with Kyodai.
relations.quote: Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

citation.text: Portrait of Michiko (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Calls Kyodai her dear one and would not wish her in the House.
relations.quote: This spirit is too small to be my dear one.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Merge as sisters to fight O-Kagachi.
relations.quote: The two sisters merge and return armed to face the still slowly descending O-Kagachi.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Imperials". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Kyodai / That Which Was Taken , the child of O-Kagachi, imprisoned by the daimyo Konda

citation.text: "Kami", section "Notable kami". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Fight together as the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.
relations.quote: Michiko and Kyodai, known together as the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Imprisoned her in a stone disk.
relations.quote: Konda imprisoned The Taken One in a stone disk with the carving of a dragon

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the planeswalker Tezzeret attempted to control Kyodai using a prototype Reality Chip .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Himoto embodies the emperor's relationship with Kyodai.
relations.quote: is the embodiment of the emperor's relationship with Kyodai.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Michiko Konda", section "Reign of Truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Shared power and fought O-Kagachi together.
relations.quote: Michiko and Kyodai worked together to immobilize O-Kagachi's heads one by one

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Her 'sister' spirit, merged into one entity.
relations.quote: Michiko and Kyodai then merged into a new combined entity, the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit .
